$comment: Authoring source for the ACE-Step 1.5 training pack (docs/training/01-training-pack.md). The single runtime.zip asset is the entire embedded toolchain: isolated CPython 3.11 + torch cu128 + Demucs + librosa tagger + the vendored ACE-Step 1.5 trainer + ffmpeg + htdemucs_6s weights + base-model checkpoints, built reproducibly by `just training-pack-build` from tools/training-pack/pins.json. Stage dist/runtime.zip (gitignored, multi-GB) before `just catalog-build`; catalog-publish uploads the same hashed bytes to GCS. The shell unpacks it (unpack: zip) into the version dir and spawns runtime/python.exe -I -m iblis_train --port N with cwd = the version dir and IBLIS_SESSION = the per-session secret. The sidecar binds 127.0.0.1 only, never touches the network, and refuses requests without the session header.
name: ACE-Step 1.5 Training
